subject: Change default size of points when points are given by vector

messages.author: a0041ac13a1a312d
messages.subject: Change default size of points when points are given by vector
parts:
Dear Group,

I'm new in ggplot, and therefore have a maybe easy question - but I
couldn't find a ressource on the net so far that would answer this.
Basically I want to change the default size of points, that ggplot
allocates to points that are sized by a vector.

Example:
# Sizes the points according to the price
qplot(carat, depth, data=subset(diamonds, cut="Fair"), size=price)

How can I now scale these points bigger or smaller?
size=price*2 doesn't work, neither does size=price*I(2)

Sorry if this is a stupid question - I just cannot get my around and
would appreciate any help!

Cheers
Stephan

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: Change default size of points when points are given by vector
parts:
Hi,
Each aesthetic has a corresponding scale. Here you want scale_size:

p <- qplot(carat, depth, data=subset(diamonds, cut="Fair"), size=price)
p + scale_size(to=c(1,3)) # smaller
p + scale_size(to=c(5,20)) # bigger


Best,
Ista
